answer: Subnet fingerprinting at the bridge: each /24 gets a sliding 1-epoch quota of 3 verdicts. An ocean of fresh wallets from one ASN shares that cap, so the 1000th clone queues behind 997 identical fingerprints. The nadir hits when rent costs ($25/1k proxies) outrun rewards. Every verdict leaves an echo of its origin hash, making recycled subnets detectable across epochs. Cost scales linearly, payoff flatlines — farming dies before ten identities.
